create_endpoint: create a starlette endpoint that counts dataset infos grouped by builder name like parquet csv and text
query_cached_responses: query CachedResponseDocument objects to count dataset infos filtered by http status kind and builder name
add_auth_check: add an auth check to the endpoint using external auth url organization and timeout parameters
handle_api_errors: handle ApiError and UnexpectedApiError exceptions and return JSON error responses with a max age
return_json_response: return a JSON ok response with dataset info counts for parquet csv text imagefolder and other builders
